Discrete NISRA colour scales

Source: R/scale_discrete.R
scale_colour_discrete_nisra.Rd

Discrete NISRA colour scales

Usage

scale_colour_discrete_nisra(reverse = FALSE, ...)

scale_fill_discrete_nisra(reverse = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

reverse

Reverse the palette, default FALSE

...

Additional arguments passed on to ggplot2::discrete_scale()

Examples

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mpg, aes(cty, colour = factor(drv), fill = factor(drv))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_discrete_nisra() +
  scale_colour_discrete_nisra()
